question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 4.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**abundance**" means a very large quantity of something.
 
• In the context of the passage, **"abundance of light elements" fits appropriately as it aligns with the scientific terminology used.**
 
• The other options: "**plenty**," "**fortune**," and "**success**" do not fit the context as precisely.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 3**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *The Big Bang theory is supported by a abundance__ of observational evidence, including the cosmic microwave background radiation, the __abundance__ of light elements in the universe and the large-scale structure of the cosmos.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Plenty:** means many or enough of something.
 
• **Fortune:** means chance or luck as an arbitrary force affecting human affairs.
 
• **Success:** means the accomplishment of an aim or purpose.
